title: Madrid Residency Concludes — 10 Sold-Out Nights, ~630,000 Fans; "The Best Is Saved for Last"
detail: Bad Bunny closes his historic 10-night Madrid residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano with Cluster 5 (Nights 9–10, June 14–15). Night 9 (June 14) brought out Lunay for 'Soltera (Remix),' one of the residency's most celebrated collaborations. The closing Night 10 (June 15) featured three guests — opening act Chuwi, Dei V, and Quevedo, the only Spanish artist invited across all ten dates. 'There's a saying that the best is saved for last,' Bad Bunny told the crowd, adding 'these ten nights in Madrid will stay in my heart forever.' With approximately 63,000 fans per night (per Atlético de Madrid), the residency drew a cumulative total of roughly 630,000 attendees across ten sold-out shows, becoming one of the biggest musical events of the summer in Spain. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour resumes June 20 in Düsseldorf, Germany.
